diagram_previews.alt: Tall isosceles triangle ABC with apex angle 20 degrees at A and base angles 80 degrees; P on AB with the blue segment PC, angle BPC = 30 degrees and angle PCB = 70 degrees marked; the shaded equilateral triangle BCD lies inside, with D on the dashed axis from A, and dashed segments DB and DC.

difficulty_rationale: The key is the auxiliary equilateral triangle on BC (hinted in the post), after which an ASA congruence with the triangle CAP must be spotted.
